answer_text: Yes. Cato supports IPv6-only branch sites. The Cato Client can connect to the Cato Cloud over IPv6-only last-mile networks and uses NAT64 to translate IPv6 addresses to IPv4 when needed. For Socket sites, IPv6-only connectivity is supported (IPv6 for Socket sites is available on Socket v26.0.23517+); IPv4 connectivity can be preserved over IPv6 using IPIP6 Static or IPv4-over-IPv6 tunneling. Roadmap dates for next year aren’t available in the knowledge base; I can escalate to obtain official roadmap details if you’d like.
